reference.title: tagdictionary-BooleanFilter
reference.shortdesc: BooleanFilter is one of several possible validity conditions subproperties, which are used to specify a certain criteria to be met in order for a tag to be applied to an object.

section.p: For example, the BooleanFilter condition slot has a Filter subproperty containing the NEQL predicate which queries objects in the station for the tags: hs:equip or hs:chiller. If the query returns true for any object (as having one of more of the queried tags), the validity criteria has been met. So the parent definition's tag(s) and/or relation(s) become implied for those objects.
